tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Joint Tenders are not allowed. The offer of the Consultant, who does not qualify for the above pre-qualification norms, will not be considered for further evaluation.
Past experience and Quality of services of tenderer will be considered for evaluation and will be rejected if found bad record.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The firm must have minimum 10 years of experience in the field of civil engineering consultancy in preparation of DPR, providing design, project management and consulting services for State/Central Government and their undertaking agencies.

The Consultancy Firm/Company should have successfully completed minimum One single work comprised for Lakes DPR works for a cost not less than 32 crores as Prime consultant in similar Lake Developmental/Lake front development Works in in Urban Conditions in Past 3 years for any Central/ State Government (Ministry / Department / Undertaking / PSU / Autonomous body/ ULBs). In support of this, the Consultant shall furnish Certificates duly certified by the Competent Authority of Rank not below the Executive Engineer.

The Consultancy Firm/Company should have successfully completed preparation of DPR for minimum three works for a cost not less than 20 crores as Prime consultant as Prime consultant in similar Lake Developmental Works in Urban Conditions within Past 3 years for any Central/ State Government (Ministry / Department / Undertaking / PSU / Autonomous body/ ULBs). In support of this, the Consultant shall furnish Certificates duly certified by the Competent Authority of Rank not below the Executive Engineer.

Consultants must have Key professional required (as detailed in Terms of Reference) having experience in construction supervision of works to be deployed exclusively for this consultancy contract. The employer or competent authority shall furnish the CVs of the personnel and the availability of the personnel for the project till completion of the assignment.
Consultancy Firm Must Have a valid ISO certificate as consultancy services provider from Government approved/ registered Firm/Any Engineering College can apply.
Consultants must have an NABL certified Laboratory and should upload the relevant document with TC number and should be eligible to conduct tests and issue reports.
Consultancy Firm should be provided with insurance against the risks. Shall be specified by providing ESIC Certificate & EPF Certificate.
Consultant should provide with latest Valid GST certificate should be submitted as proof along with latest paid GST returns copy to be uploaded.
Consultant should have Established Office locally and should be running office from past 10 years. Proof of certificate issued from Labour Department should be submitted.

Achieved at least in any Two Financial Year a minimum annual Financial Turnover (in all classes of Civil Engineering Consultation Works only) of Rs. 300.00 Lakhs in last Three years (from 2023-24 to 2025-26). In support of this, the Consultant shall furnish the Audited Balance Sheets along with the Technical Proposal.
